_doc: Human-adjudicated AOI corrections applied on top of the upstream organic-boundary-data extractor. Each entry maps a trial_id to per-trial corrections. Currently supported: demote_to_widget (list of organic positions to reclassify as widget). After demotion, remaining organic positions are renumbered contiguously (survivors keep their upstream rank as source_position). Add a 'note' field to record why. expected_bbox pins each demoted position to the bbox it was adjudicated against ({pos: {y, height}}, page-space px): a bare integer position is not stable across upstream regenerations, so apply_aoi_corrections() skips the demotion loudly if the bbox at that position has drifted more than 4px.

p048-b1-t6.note: Position 11 is Google 'Images for...' inline image carousel; extractor missed it (widget detector only catches bottom-of-page refinement widgets). Re-verified 2026-08-30 against the post-collision-fix AllSERP v1.1.0 maps: organic-boundary pos 11 (y=2006, h=286) matches the typed map's image_pack card at rso[9] (y=2006, h=286) exactly, so the demotion is corroborated by the typed extractor and stays.
